title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
script:
You can get a religious exemption from using AI at work.
A University of Kentucky administrator recently secured this exact legal accommodation.
The employee argued that mandatory AI usage violates his sincerely held beliefs.
Federal law protects workers who hold non-theistic moral or ethical convictions.
You do not need to follow a formal religion to qualify for protection.
This sets a new standard for workers facing mandatory generative software requirements.
Would you ask for an AI exemption at your job?
